presentation.description: Screen + View + ViewModel + ViewState/Event/Action; shared UI error types (UiText, Content, UserMessage) and the LightDarkPreview annotation

navigation.description: Navigation 3 by the Google recipes: Navigator over NavBackStack created in AppNavHost (not in DI), sealed AppNavKey and @Serializable screen keys, transitions as lambdas, session state collected by the host

usecase.description: Business logic — one UseCase per action (operator invoke); UseCase base interface and domain models

repository.description: Domain-data boundary; interface + implementation returning ApiResult<KtorX>

data.description: DataSources on ApiClient, Ktor data models, Ktor -> domain mappers

network.description: ApiClient, ApiResult, ApiError — the only way to the network; errors as values

session.description: App-wide session state (StateFlow<SessionState>); ApiClient expires it on 401, AppNavHost reacts — events outside screens as state

di.description: Koin module on the Koin Compiler Plugin DSL (compile-time graph verification)
